gameDescriptionHtml:
The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC 26. Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback, Manager Live Challenges that bring fresh storylines to the new season, and Archetypes inspired by greats of the game.

Game Features

  • Overhauled Gameplay Experience – The new Authentic Gameplay preset delivers the most true-to-football experience ever in Career, while the Competitive Gameplay preset-driven by refined fundamentals, added consistency, and enhanced responsiveness.
  • Build Your Dream Squad – Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team with Tournaments and Live Events, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience. Tournaments will test your skills with up to four rounds of knockout football, while Live Events add more variety with themed competitions and content all season long.
  • Take on New Live Challenges – Experience Manager Career like never before with all-new Manager Live Challenges. Earn rewards throughout the new season by taking on a variety of real-world scenarios and alternative storylines-ranging from a few minutes of play to multiple seasons.
  • Inspired by Greats of the Game – Archetypes inspired by the greats of the game introduce new classes to Clubs and Player Career, bringing more individuality to your player. Develop your abilities by upgrading attributes and unlocking Archetype Perks to give your player a distinct feel on the pitch.
  • Play solo or with Clubmates – Play solo or with Clubmates in Clubs Rush Live Events, introducing a range of exciting new knockout Tournaments to Clubs in EA SPORTS FC 26. With varying entry requirements and gameplay rules.
  • The Club is in your hand – Play EA SPORTS FC 26 your way on PC by using your PlayStation or Xbox controllers.
  • Connect and compete across platforms – Play together with friends on consoles in your favorite game modes including Football Ultimate Team, Online Seasons, and Clubs.
